description: A script for integrating MISP with Cytomic Orion, managing event and attribute uploads/deletions via API, including configuration fetching, token management, and event processing.

classes.name: cytomicobject
classes.description: A class encapsulating the state and configuration for Cytomic API interactions, including methods for event and attribute processing.

methods.name: get_token
methods.description: Fetches an OAuth2 access token using provided credentials and token URL.

methods.name: get_config
methods.description: Retrieves and parses the module configuration from MISP, returning relevant settings.

methods.name: collect_events_ids
methods.description: Collects event IDs from MISP that contain a specific Cytomic tag.

methods.name: find_eventid
methods.description: Checks if a specific event ID is in the list of collected event IDs.

methods.name: print_result_events
methods.description: Prints messages related to event processing results.

methods.name: set_postdata
methods.description: Prepares JSON data for API submission based on event attributes.

methods.name: send_postdata
methods.description: Sends batched attribute data to Cytomic API.

methods.name: process_attributes
methods.description: Retrieves and processes attributes of specific types for upload or deletion.

methods.name: untag_event
methods.description: Removes the Cytomic tag from an event after processing.

methods.name: process_events
methods.description: Coordinates fetching, processing, and untagging of events with Cytomic tag.

methods.name: untag_attributes
methods.description: Removes Cytomic tags from processed attributes.
